candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout); order's own /v1/orders p95 is ~2387ms, matching the gateway timeout, so the failure originates in order-side latency rather than the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order metrics show postgres save_order succeeding and no dependency errors, so the slow hop within order is not yet localized; payment ReadTimeouts appear in traces but payment also returns 200 later.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with gateway-to-order transport ReadTimeouts at ~2s, and order /v1/orders p95 (~2387ms) matches that timeout, indicating downstream latency at order. The specific slow dependency inside order is not yet established, so the candidate is bounded to downstream latency pending order-side traces.
